svg.title: Softmax regions are unchanged when every parameter vector is shifted by the same amount
svg.desc: Two panels of the same three overlapping clusters, shaded by the class the softmax model predicts. Dashed lines mark where each class score theta k transpose x equals zero. On the right every theta k has had the same vector added: the dashed lines have moved to quite different places, but the shaded regions are identical, because only differences between class scores decide the prediction.
svg.text: θₖ + c, same c for every k
